subject: Leadership presence for GridWorks demo — exec escort & backup plan
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@gridworks.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@gridworks.com>, GridWorks Procurement <procurement@gridworks.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec presence for Redwood run-through?

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We're lining up the internal exec run for the Redwood demo and want to confirm leadership attendance. Our CIO (Sanjay Rao) and one of our VPs are hoping to attend a 30-minute run to focus on deployment model, data isolation (VPC/on-prem options), and SLAs.

Candidate windows that work for our execs: Oct 22, 10:00–10:30 PT or Oct 23, 14:00–14:30 PT. If you can confirm whether a VP or CIO-level sponsor from Redwood will join, that would help lock the room — otherwise we'll accept a senior technical sponsor with a quick handoff to procurement afterward.

Attaching a short agenda and the procurement checklist (stub). If you think a compact 20–25 minute executive walkthrough plus 5–10 minutes for procurement questions is better, we're flexible.

Attachments: GridWorks-Exec-Agenda.pdf (PDF stub)

Appreciate it —
Sonia
Sonia Patel
Director, Cloud Programs | GridWorks
sonia.patel@gridworks.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@gridworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec presence for Redwood run-through?

Hi Sonia — thanks for the agenda and the windows. Happy to take point on executive coordination for Redwood.

Quick notes:
- I can be the Redwood sponsor and will coordinate who joins from leadership. Our VP of Product is expected to be in meetings most of that week, but our CTO or Head of Solutions can join as the exec-level technical sponsor. We prefer the Oct 22, 10:00–10:30 PT window; can hold the 23rd as a backup.
- Proposed flow: 20-min exec overview (value/risks/deployment choices) + 10-min procurement/Q&A. That keeps the conversation tight for CIO time.
- I attached our internal demo runbook and a compact slide list so everyone knows who's covering what.

@Ben — can you confirm coverage for the deployment/latency slides and the 1-slide cost/quantization summary?
@Lauren — if procurement needs a follow-up, can you take point to move paperwork and next steps?

If that all sounds good I'll send a calendar hold once Sonia confirms.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood-Demo-Runbook.md (markdown stub); Exec-slide-list.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec presence for Redwood run-through?

On Tue, Oct 14, 2025 at 9:12 AM Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@gridworks.com> wrote:
> Hi Markus,
>
> Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We're lining up the internal exec run for the Redwood demo...

All good from my side — happy to be the technical escort if CTO/VP can't join. Quick draft of what I'll cover in the 20-minute portion:

- 3 min: high-level platform value (unified runtime + deployment modes)
- 5 min: latency/cost guardrails — real numbers from similar customers (p95 & unit economics)
- 6 min: security & private deployment highlights (VPC/KMS/HSM + audit logs)
- 3 min: rollout options + fallback routing and SLA considerations
- 3 min: short demo snippet (streaming response, function calling example)

I'll keep slides tight and make sure there's a single slide for procurement that answers the common T&Cs + billing model questions.

Lauren — please confirm procurement owner for follow-up. Markus — go ahead and book Oct 22, 10:00–10:30 PT as a hold; I'll prep a 1-page summary to drop into the invite.

—Ben

If you can include the runbook link and a one-pager on private deployment options in the invite, that would be great.

Confirming attachments received.

See you then,
